clips.title: The story
paras: In Sen'jin Village, Zjolnir raises raptors for Darkspear riders and trusted Horde champions. His trained mounts carry deep cultural pride for troll riders.

Near Sen'jin Village's pens, Zjolnir raises the fierce raptors the Darkspear favor as mounts. Predatory and temperamental, they need an expert hand before they can be raised and saddled for war. Zjolnir freely gives these prized mounts to fellow trolls who have learned the riding arts. Other Horde members must first earn the Darkspear tribe's exalted trust before he will entrust them with one of his raptors.
